reports.title: Knee, Rope, Backpack
reports.eyebrow: Real-world RL · MuJoCo as the real world
reports.summary: Three perturbations a Booster T1 could not walk with — a locked knee, a rope on the ankle, an 8 kg backpack. All three go from 0–2 to 9–10 of 10 episodes surviving, on 3.5 h of data collected outside IsaacSim.

reports.title: Eight Conditions, Nothing Forgotten
reports.eyebrow: Continual RL · MuJoCo as the real world
reports.summary: One steering policy over a frozen flow policy learns 8 body and terrain conditions in a row, without labels. Plain fine-tuning ends at 0.29 mean survival over all 8; with a KL anchor to the previous steering policy, 0.86–0.88.

reports.title: Trained in 2-D, Played in Isaac
reports.summary: A 3 v 3 T1 soccer policy trained only in a 2-D world fitted to Isaac data, played zero-shot in Isaac Lab. Against three unseen behaviour trees it wins 0.57 of games in 2-D but 0.36 in Isaac; replays of both worlds side by side.
